description: Opus X unit B1: setItem's singleEvent('Start') runs for a holder ignoring its item. Snorlax's Growl (setup turn) lowers both p1 Pokémon's Attack; then Alakazam Tricks its White Herb onto Klutz Lopunny (no item): White Herb's onStart uses the item (useItem), but its onUse (the stage reset) is a singleEvent that Klutz suppresses, so the herb is gone and Lopunny stays at -1 Attack.
